Question: How many people who ate together are obligated to make a zimmun?

Sources:
[0] Berakhot 45a:13 (Berakhot)
תא שמע שלשה שאכלו כאחת חייבין לזמן ואין רשאין ליחלק שלשה אין שנים לא
Come and hear : Three who ate together are under the obligation of Zimmun and are not permitted to divide themselves up. [Hence it is to be inferred that] three can and two cannot make Zimmun !

[1] Berakhot 45a:11 (Berakhot)
תנן שלשה שאכלו כאחת חייבין לזמן שלשה אין שנים לא
There is, however, the Mishnaic teaching : Three who ate together are under the obligation of Zimmun — three, yes ; two, no !

[2] Berakhot 45a:4 (Berakhot)
מתני׳ שלשה שאכלו כאחת חייבין לזמן אכל דמאי ומעשר ראשון שנטלה תרומתו מעשר שני והקדש שנפדו והשמש שאכל כזית והכותי מזמנין עליו
MISHNAH Three who ate together are under the obligation of Zimmun. One who has eaten Demai, or the first tithe from which Terumah has been taken, or the second tithe or food belonging to the Sanctuary which had been redeemed, and the attendant who has eaten food the size of an olive and the Samaritan may be included for Zimmun.

[3] Berakhot 50a:20 (Berakhot)
גמ׳ מאי קמ"ל תנינא חדא זימנא ג' שאכלו כאחת חייבין לזמן
GEMARA What does he wish to tell us? We have already learnt in the Mishnah : Three who ate together are under the obligation of Zimmun!

[4] Berakhot 45b:18 (Berakhot)
יהודה בר מרימר ומר בר רב אשי ורב אחא מדפתי כרכי ריפתא בהדי הדדי לא הוה בהו חד דהוה מופלג מחבריה לברוכי להו (יתבי וקא מיבעיא להו) הא דתנן שלשה שאכלו כאחת חייבין לזמן הני מילי היכא דאיכא אדם גדול אבל היכא דכי הדדי נינהו חלוק ברכות עדיף
Judah b. Maremar, Mar b. Rab Ashe and Rab Aha of Difti dined together, and there was not one amongst them who was more distinguished than his associates to say Grace for them. They sat on and said : The Mishnah teaches : Three who ate together are under the obligation of Zimmun. That must refer only to where there is an eminent man present, but where they are all equal, it is preferable to separate for the purpose of the Grace.

[5] Berakhot 49b:6 (Berakhot)
עד כמה מזמנין וכו':
How much [must one have eaten at the meal] to he included for Zimmun ?

[6] Berakhot 50a:17 (Berakhot)
מתני׳ ג' שאכלו כאחת אינן רשאין ליחלק וכן ד' וכן חמשה ו' נחלקין עד עשרה ועשרה אין נחלקין עד כ'
MISHNAH Three who have eaten together are not permitted to separate [before Grace], and, similarly with four or five. Six may divide themselves [into two parties for Zimmun] up to ten. But ten may not divide themselves up, [and similarly] up to twenty.

[7] Berakhot 50a:15 (Berakhot)
אמר רבה תוספאה הני ג' דכרכי רפתא בהדי הדדי וקדים חד מינייהו ובריך לדעתיה אינון נפקין בזמון דידיה איהו לא נפיק בזמון דידהו לפי שאין זמון למפרע:
Rabbah Tospaah said : If three were dining together, and one finishing before the others says Grace for himself, they fulfil the obligation of Zimmun with him, but not he with them ; because the Zimmun cannot be retrospective.

Answer segments:
(0) sources=[]: **Three.** The Mishnah states: 
(1) sources=[2]: שלשה שאכלו כאחת חייבין לזמן
(2) sources=[]: , i.e., 
(3) sources=[2]: Three who ate together are under the obligation of Zimmun.
(4) sources=[]: 

**Why not two?** The Gemara reads the Mishnah precisely: 
(5) sources=[1]: Three who ate together are under the obligation of Zimmun — three, yes ; two, no!
(6) sources=[]:  (
(7) sources=[1]: שלשה אין שנים לא
(8) sources=[]: ). A parallel teaching adds that the three 
(9) sources=[0]: are not permitted to divide themselves up
(10) sources=[]: .

**Larger groups:** A later Mishnah says 
(11) sources=[6]: Three who have eaten together are not permitted to separate [before Grace], and, similarly with four or five. Six may divide themselves [into two parties for Zimmun] up to ten. But ten may not divide themselves up, [and similarly] up to twenty.
(12) sources=[]: 

**A qualification:** Judah b. Maremar, Mar b. Rav Ashi and Rav Aha of Difti, dining together as equals, reasoned that the Mishnah's rule 
(13) sources=[4]: must refer only to where there is an eminent man present, but where they are all equal, it is preferable to separate for the purpose of the Grace.
(14) sources=[]: 

**If one finishes early:** Rabbah Tospaah said 
(15) sources=[7]: If three were dining together, and one finishing before the others says Grace for himself, they fulfil the obligation of Zimmun with him, but not he with them ; because the Zimmun cannot be retrospective.
(16) sources=[]:
